source_provenance: Baseline identifies starting checkout; raw input/in-image hashes identify tested feature sources. LF-normalized hashes identify Git blobs without changing Windows runner bytes.

scope.management: two independent 9-volume cells and active/passive processes on ONE parent Docker engine and PC
scope.service_hosts: two DinD CA/PG daemons reused; no combined service-host and management-loss recovery matrix
scope.coordination: trusted surviving host executor and local kernel/file lease; explicit pinned process fencing; no quorum/election
scope.credential_scope: offline root/JWK and backup-key jobs have network=none; online controllers have no vault/socket
scope.baseline: application/detection/policy/evaluation unchanged; no AWS or paid model calls

windows.duration_note: Single observed pytest report, not an application latency or SLA benchmark.

linux.duration_note: Single observed pytest report, not an application latency or SLA benchmark.

limits: No physical host/disk/management-daemon isolation, multi-site HA, automatic election, consensus or malicious-admin fencing.
Trusted host executor/file lease and workload certificate volumes remain shared. Application SQLite/session data HA is outside scope.
Only idle/prepared checkpoints; unfinished operations/publication refuse takeover. No automatic recovery of crashes during takeover itself.
No combined CA-host restoration plus management-loss failure matrix, independent teammate review, production SLA/RPO/RTO or global rollback protection.

verification_notes.inventory_method: Separate Docker CLI queries by the same executor, not independent teammate review.
